rollback_criteria: disable provider=auto if timeout_rate exceeds 10 percent in the daily threshold replay
disable provider=auto if operator review marks any provider sample batch as failed
fall back to explicit provider selection if a provider returns fewer than 3 visible results
monitoring_requirements: daily symbolic live quality replay for searxng, yacy, and web
manual review of at least 3 visible samples per provider before promotion renewal
record source-domain count, relevance, freshness, timeout rate, and p95 latency per provider
